sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B · Models · The Open-Source AI Stack
sources.snippet: Dense Qwen2.5-32B base supervised-fine-tuned on reasoning traces sampled from DeepSeek-R1. The sweet-spot distill of the series: small enough to run on a single high-memory GPU, and reported by DeepSeek as outperforming OpenAI o1-mini on AIME 2024 and MATH-500.
